subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calls, structured outputs) - owners & ETA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (integration build plan)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Per our call, I attached the initial Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) with the milestones we discussed. High level recap:

- Goal: Production-ready integration for Acme Search Assistant using Redwood Hosted API and Dedicated option for initial rollout.
- Target close: 2027-07-15 (business/legal sign + Dedicated reservation)
- Key MAP milestones included in the spreadsheet:
  1) Procurement & PO (legal + finance) — Owner: Acme
  2) Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calls, structured outputs) — Owner: Redwood Eng + Acme Eng
  3) Security review & SOC2 scoping — Owner: Redwood Security / Acme InfoSec
  4) Pilot & performance validation — Owner: Acme Eng + Redwood CS

Action items I promised:
- Share MAP draft (attached) — please confirm milestones and target close date.
- Clarify integration owners & ETA for the "Integration build plan" milestone (SDK integration, streaming responses, tool-calling hooks, structured outputs).

Samir — could you confirm the Acme-side owner for the integration work and whether the 7/15 target looks ok? If yes, we can lock in the MAP and start the SOW/technical onboarding items.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), integration_sow_draft.pdf (SOW skeleton)

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (integration build plan)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick answers from our side:

- PO/Procurement: I'll coordinate with procurement (they want a finalized SOW + termination language) — target to issue PO by 2027-07-10 if legal review goes smoothly.
- Acme integration owner: Priya Malhotra (Engineering Manager, Search) — cc'd on my internal thread (I'll loop her in after confirming with procurement).
- The 7/15 target is aggressive but doable if we parallelize legal + technical onboarding.

A couple of technical questions for your eng team (want to confirm before we assign internal owners):
1) SDKs: Do you have an official JS + Python SDK with streaming support and structured output guidance?
2) Streaming: We're planning to stream partial responses into our UI — what are the recommended latency/cost tradeoffs for continuous streaming vs chunked batching?
3) Tool calling / actions: We need to call our internal knowledge-service for entity resolution. Do you recommend running tool-call hooks via Redwood-managed webhooks or embedding a local adapter on our side?

If you can loop in engineering with recommended owners and a provisional ETA for the "Integration build plan" milestone, that will help us finalize Priya's availability.

Thanks —
Samir
Director, Product
Acme Corp
samir.shah@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + next steps (integration build plan)

Team — forwarding Samir's reply (below). Acme has confirmed Priya as the Eng owner on their side pending procurement. They asked three specific technical questions we should answer in the MAP and during the kickoff:

  1) SDKs: official JS + Python SDK with streaming & structured output guidance
  2) Streaming: latency/cost tradeoffs (continuous streaming vs chunked batching)
  3) Tool calling: recommended pattern (Redwood-managed webhook vs local adapter)

Please propose:
- A named owner from Redwood for the Integration build plan milestone (this will be the primary eng contact for kickoff and ETA)
- A short owner-level ETA (date) for milestone completion (we're treating this as the "integration readiness" checkpoint — plugin + streaming + toolcall wiring + structured output spec)
- Any dependencies (e.g., feature flags, Dedicated reservation, dataset access, Priya's team availability)

Samir is cc'd — please keep replies concise so I can fold into MAP v1 and send back to Acme.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa / Samir / team —

Happy to own the Redwood side of the "Integration build plan" milestone. Proposed breakdown and ETA:

Owner: Dylan Brooks (Engineering Lead, Integrations) — dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Supporting: Neha Kapoor (Platform Eng - runtime/streaming) for streaming & KV/cache guidance; Rachel Kim (Solutions Eng) for SDK examples and structured-output schema.

Provisional ETA for milestone completion (deliverables = SDK examples, streaming guidance doc, tool-call pattern recommendation, structured-output spec + sample): 2027-06-18.

Dependencies / notes:
- Dedicated reservation recommended for predictable latency during pilot — procurement + SRE scheduling may add 2 weeks to onboarding if not pre-reserved.
- Need Priya's team to provide a staging endpoint and auth method (token exchange) for tool-call wiring by 2027-05-20 to hit ETA.
- We'll provide a short "integration playbook" and sample code (JS + Python) for streaming and structured outputs — aim to hand off to Acme devs by 2027-06-04 for integration work.

Samir — if that timeline works, I'll create a short MAP sub-row with the owners & dates and Marissa can push MAP v1 back to you. If you prefer an earlier pilot date we can compress but will need Priya & procurement to accelerate.

Thanks —
Dylan
